info.name: Comaney API
info.description:
Comaney REST API v2. Set the `base_url` and `api_key` collection variables before use.

**Authentication**: every request needs `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`; generate the key in Settings.

**Dates**: ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`). **Types**: `expense`, `income`, `savings_dep`, `savings_wit`.

**Periods**: `date_from`/`date_to` together, or `year`/`month`/`view`; anything left out falls back to the current financial month.

Generated by `manage.py export_postman_collection` from the API registry (api/registry.py).

request.description: List expenses in a period (default: current financial month), optionally filtered by a query.
Sum expenses of one type in a period, optionally filtered by a query and grouped. In shared mode foreign and shared expenses count at the feuser's own share.
One expense the feuser owns, administers as project admin, or participates in.
Create an expense (default settled, due today). With an assignment it is shared; participants and payers are notified like in the web app.
Change an own expense; only given fields change. assignment replaces the sharing (null makes it personal). Changing title, value, participants or shares resets participant approvals.
Delete one own expense. Confirmed settlements cannot be deleted.
Copy an own expense, participants included, as "CLONE - <title>".
The feuser's own category, tags and note on a foreign expense they participate in.
Set the feuser's own category, tags and note on a foreign expense; the owner's classification is untouched. Omitted fields are cleared.

Apply one action to many expenses. Tag and category actions on foreign expenses change the feuser's own overlay. delete is two-step: without confirm_token nothing is deleted and the matching expenses plus a confirm_token (10 minutes) come back; repeat the call with that token to delete exactly those. Settlements are never bulk deleted.
All recurring expense templates.
One recurring expense template.
Create a recurring expense; due occurrences of the current financial year are generated at once.

Change a recurring expense; only given fields change. Repeat factor/unit change only with confirm_modify_schedule (regenerates this financial year's occurrences, settled ones too); base date/end only with confirm_modify_schedule_window. Unconfirmed changes are discarded.
Delete a recurring expense template; expenses it already generated stay.
Copy a recurring expense template as "CLONE - <title>".
Expenses this template generated in the current financial year.
Copy the template's current fields and sharing onto some of its generated expenses (ids from scheduled_generated). Resets participant approvals on them.
All of the feuser's categories.
One category.
Create a category. Catalog partners get the same change.
Rename a category. Catalog partners get the same change.
Delete a category; expenses lose it. Catalog partners get the same change.
All of the feuser's tags.
One tag.
Create a tag. Catalog partners get the same change.
Rename a tag. Catalog partners get the same change.
Delete a tag; expenses lose it. Catalog partners get the same change.
Income, paid and outstanding expenses, savings and resulting balance of one financial month (default current), own expenses only.
The feuser's dashboards in display order.
Add an empty dashboard after the existing ones.
Rename a dashboard.
Delete a dashboard with its cards. The last dashboard cannot be deleted.
A dashboard's cards (default: first dashboard) with their data computed for a period.
The documentation of the card YAML schema and the query language. Read it before writing a card.
Add a card to a dashboard (default: first dashboard). Placement comes from the YAML positioning block.
Replace a card's YAML and/or move it to another dashboard.
Delete a card.
The feuser's projects with their balance in each (positive: others owe the feuser) and total spending, plus incoming project invitations.

A project with members, settings, the feuser's simplified debts in it (positive: that person owes the feuser) and, for the admin, open invitations. All expenses, shares and balances between all members: projects_overview.

Everything the project pages show, independent of period and sharing mode: all members including offline ones with their balance (positive: others owe them), every expense and settlement with payer and each member's share, the expense flows between members (opposite flows cancelled) and the fewest payments that settle everyone. Only approved entries count towards balances, flows and total_spending. approval is a participant's consent; a settlement's status is its approved flag.
Create a project with the feuser as admin and only member.

Change a project; only given fields change. name, description and ai_preprompt (instructions AI Express follows for this project) need edit rights; permission_laxity and archived are admin only. An archived project blocks changes to its expenses.
Delete a project with all its expenses. Admin only; confirm_name must equal the project name.
Invite someone by email, or a contact by feuser_id. Contacts who auto-accept the feuser's invitations join at once; others get an email. Admin only.
Withdraw an open invitation of the project. Admin only.
Accept or decline an incoming project invitation (ids from projects_list or pending_list).
Add an offline member (someone without an account). Admin only.
Rename an offline member (member_id = their offline id from projects_get). Admin only.
Remove a member (member_id from projects_get). A removed feuser's history stays under an offline stand-in; an offline member's history moves to the project's Achim Archive. Admin only.
Hand admin rights to another member feuser. Admin only.
Leave a project; the admin must transfer admin rights first.
Take an expense out of the project; it stays with its owner as a personal expense.
Delete an expense of the project: own expenses, and for the admin offline-paid expenses. Approved settlements stay.
Contacts and offline contacts with the balance of personal shared expenses (positive: they owe the feuser), auto-accept flags, projects in common, and open outgoing invitations.
Invite someone as a contact by email, or a known feuser (e.g. a fellow project member) by feuser_id. They get an email and must accept.
Withdraw an own outgoing contact invitation.
Accept or decline an incoming contact invitation (ids from pending_list).
End a contact link (link_id from contacts_list). Shared history stays.
Automatically accept expenses, settlements and project invitations this contact records. Enabling also accepts everything of theirs that is pending.
Add an offline contact: someone without an account to split personal expenses with.
Rename an offline contact.
Remove an offline contact; their history moves to the feuser's Achim Archive. With an open balance pass accept_balance=true.

Everything waiting for the feuser's decision: expenses recorded with them as upfront payer, settlements to confirm as creditor, shared expenses awaiting their consent, project admin decisions for offline members, and incoming contact, project and partnership invitations.

Answer a pending item. kind=paid: confirm or deny having paid upfront (deny removes the feuser and redistributes shares). kind=settlement: confirm or deny receiving a payment (deny deletes it and tells the debtor). kind=consent: approve or reject a shared expense. kind=admin: as project admin, confirm or reject for an offline member (reject deletes it).

Recorded settlements, newest first. With project_id: every settlement in that project. Without: every settlement the feuser paid or received, with contacts and in projects. payer paid recipient; status pending means the recipient has not confirmed receipt yet and the debt still stands.

Record a payment that settles debt. Without project_id: the feuser paid a contact (creditor), or with debtor an own offline contact paid the feuser. With project_id: a payment between two members; non-admins can only record their own payments. Real creditors must confirm receipt. The money itself is not moved.
As project admin, record settlements for every open debt in the project at once and email all members.

The feuser's Catalog Partnership: partners share one category and tag catalog, so every change to a category or tag reaches all of them. Shows partners, open invitations and any invitation to the feuser.
Invite a contact or fellow project member (feuser_id) into the feuser's Catalog Partnership.
Withdraw an open invitation of the feuser's partnership.
Remove a partner from the partnership; they keep a copy of the catalog.
Leave the partnership; the feuser keeps a copy of the catalog.

For the open invitation to the feuser: the inviter's catalog and the feuser's own tags and categories, split into matched (same title) and unmatched. Joining replaces the feuser's catalog with the inviter's, so every unmatched title needs a target or an explicit drop.

Check complete mappings and show what joining would do to each own title and how many expenses, recurring expenses and overlays carry them. Changes nothing; returns a confirm_token (10 minutes) for partnership_onboarding_apply.
Join the partnership with exactly the previewed mappings: the feuser's catalog is replaced and their records remapped. Refused when anything changed since the preview.
Decline the open partnership invitation to the feuser.
The feuser's profile and settings, never any secret.
Change profile and settings; only given fields change. email_notifications=false turns every email off. Email, password, second factors and API keys are not changeable here.
